description: OPPO is combining AI-powered imaging, computational photography and creator-led insights to build a premium smartphone camera ecosystem designed around how India captures, creates and shares today.
title: How OPPO Is Designing Smartphone Imaging for the Way India Captures Today

description: The second quarter of 2026 has become the most exploited quarter in crypto history by the number of incidents, with 83 hacks recorded across the industry. According to data analysed by Unfolded and DefiLlama, losses have reached $755.3 million so far, led by the KelpDAO and Drift Protocol exploits. While total losses remain below previous record highs, the growing frequency of attacks highlights persistent security challenges across decentralised finance and blockchain infrastructure.
title: Crypto Sector Sees Record 83 Hacks in Q2 2026, Most-Exploited Quarter to Date: Report

description: Capcom has announced the next Capcom Spotlight broadcast for this week. The presentation will take place on June 25 and will feature games like Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Monster Hunter Stories 3, and Dragon's Dogma 2. The show will be 30 minutes long, Capcom said.
title: Capcom Spotlight Broadcast Announced for June 25; Onimusha: Way of the Sword to Get New Look

description: Asus launched new ROG series laptops in India earlier this month. Now, all these models are available for purcahse in the country. The lineup includes ROG Zephyrus G14 and G16 series, ProArt PZ14 laptops alongside the refreshed TUF Gaming A14. They come with Nvidia GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics. The ROG Zephyrus Duo runs on an Intel Core Ultra 9 Series 3 processor, while the ROG Zephyrus G16 runs on an Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processor.
title: Asus ROG Zephyrus Duo, G14, G16, ProArt PZ14 and TUF Gaming A14 Go on Sale in India: Prices Start at Rs 1.99 Lakh

description: Ethereum layer-2 network Taiko has advised users to withdraw funds from all bridges deployed on its ecosystem after a bridge exploit resulted in losses of up to $1.7 million. The incident, linked to a flaw in the chain state verification mechanism, prompted the protocol to suspend affected systems and work with partners to contain the breach. Security researchers say the exploit exploited weaknesses in the bridge’s signal validation process.
title: Taiko Urges Users to Move Funds Following $1.7 Million Bridge Exploit

description: Redmi 17C has been launched in China as a successor to last year's Redmi 15C. The new phone features a 6.88-inch display with up to a 120Hz refresh rate and includes a 5,160mAh battery with 18W wired fast charging support. It has a MediaTek Helio chipset under the hood and carries a 13-megapixel main rear camera.
title: Redmi 17C Launched With 5,160mAh Battery, MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra Chip: Price, Features

description: Samsonite has introduced its new Waypoint luggage tracking system. Samsonite’s Waypoint lets users locate their suitcase from their smartphone. The company has launched the Zipprix FT, its first bag that features the built-in Waypoint Smart Tag. However, the company plans to install the Waypoint Smart Tag in more bags in the future. Samsonite’s Waypoint Smart Tag is compatible with both iOS and Android devices. The company says that the Waypoint luggage tracking system has been integrated into Apple’s Find My and Google’s Find Hub. This means that users do not have to download a standalone for the luggage tracking system.
title: Samsonite Zipprix FT Suitcase Unveiled With Built-In Waypoint Luggage Tracking System: Price, Features

description: Epson has revealed that the laser printer market in India will shrink, and the ink tank or inkjet printers will gain much momentum. The brand recently introduced 15 models across its EcoTank series, priced between Rs. 13,999 and Rs. 24,999. Here’s what Sivakumar Krishnamoorthy, Senior General Manager, Epson India, has to say about the future of printing in India.
title: Laser Printer Market Will Come Down and Get Replaced by Ink Tank, Says Epson’s Sivakumar

description: Hideo Kojima has shared new details about Kojima Productions' upcoming horror game, OD. The game designer has teased a completely new game system for the title. In a new interview, Kojima said that OD's new game system will push players to keep on playing even if they are scared and want to stop.
title: Hideo Kojima's Horror Title OD Will Feature 'New Game System' That Pushes Users to Keep Playing

description: Realme has launched the 4G variant of Realme P4x 4G in select global markets. It comes in two colour options and features an 8,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging support. It sports a 6.8-inch screen with up to a 120Hz refresh rate.  The Realme P4x has a 50-megapixel rear camera unit and runs on an octa-core chipset. It has an IP64-rated build. The Realme P4x 5G has a 7,000mAh battery and 45W fast charging support
title: Realme P4x Launched With 8,000mAh Battery, 6.8-Inch Display and 4G Connectivity: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo X Fold 6 will launch at a significantly higher price in China, compared to its predecessor, the Vivo X Fold 5, which was launched in the country in June 2025, a tipster claims. The upcoming foldable will reportedly go on sale via the Vivo China online store in 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB RAM and storage configurations. Moreover, the handset is expected to be equipped with a 7,000mAh battery and run on Vivo's Android 16-based OriginOS 6 Fold.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Price, Storage Variants and Key Specifications Leaked Ahead of June 26 Launch in China

description: Researchers at Kaspersky have discovered a large malware campaign targeting users of WhatsApp Desktop and WhatsApp Web. This has reportedly affected users in countries, including Malaysia, Brazil, Singapore, Taiwan and Vietnam. The highest number of victims was reported in Malaysia. The cybersecurity and anti-virus firm advises users to be careful when receiving unexpected attachments on WhatsApp. Users have to be cautious when opening script and executable file types.
title: WhatsApp Desktop, WhatsApp Web Users Targeted Using Malware Campaign, Kaspersky Warns

description: Nothing India Co-Founder and President, Akis Evangelidis, revealed on Monday that the new ‘B’ series will be positioned below the existing ‘A’ series devices. The company executive said, “The B Series builds on the success of the A Series by expanding into a new segment, while maintaining a clear product hierarchy.” Further explaining the rationale behind Nothing’s naming system, Evangelidis said that the numbers represent the generation, while the letters at the end indicate the product segment.
title: Nothing Phone 4b India Launch Date Revealed; Phone 'b' Series Will Be More Affordable Than Phone 'a' Models

description: Apple on Monday rolled out the iOS 27 Developer Beta 2 update for iPhone. Available to registered developers, it carries additions to the features that the Cupertino-based tech giant introduced with the first beta shortly after its WWDC 2026 conference earlier this month. The update includes enhancements to the Liquid Glass UI, new photo editing tools in the Photos app, and most notably, a smarter Siri with contextual awareness. With iOS 27 Developer Beta 2, Apple has also brought general stability improvements and bug fixes.
title: Apple Rolls Out iOS 27 Developer Beta 2 Update for iPhone With RCS Upgrades, New Siri Tools

description: Bitcoin traded near $63,000 on Tuesday as investors assessed easing geopolitical tensions and upcoming US economic data. Analysts said lower oil prices, improving market sentiment, and stronger on-chain activity have helped support prices, while key inflation and labour market reports remain crucial for shaping expectations around future Federal Reserve policy.
title: Bitcoin Nears Key Resistance Level as US-Iran Talks Lift Market Sentiment

description: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G will be launched in India on June 29, the South Korean smartphone maker revealed on Tuesday.  The Galaxy M47 5G will be available for purchase in India via Amazon in two colour options, namely Blaze Blue and Rogue Red. In terms of design, the handset is shown to sport a similar flat rear camera and a pill-shaped camera module as the latest Galaxy A series phones. It is confirmed to be powered by a Snapdragon chipset, along with LPDDR5x RAM and UFS 3.1 onboard storage. The phone will boast an sAMOLED screen that refreshes at up to 120Hz.
title: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G India Launch Date Announced; Key Specifications, Colour Options Revealed

description: Samsung Display has reportedly started manufacturing OLED modules for Apple's iPhone Ultra. Production of Apple's foldable OLED modules is reportedly being handled at Samsung Display's facilities in Vietnam. The rigid OLED back-end operations are taking place in China. The launch timeline of the phone could be affected by the availability of key hardware components such as the hinge. The 3D-printed hinge module is reportedly facing issues related to unwanted noise after assembly.
title: Samsung Display Said to Have Begun Manufacturing OLED Modules for iPhone Ultra, Hinge Challenges Could Impact Timeline

description: Apple has been rumoured to be preparing to increase the prices of its products sooner than expected. CEO Tim Cook, in a recent interview, warned that component costs may force the Cupertino-based tech giant to raise prices across its product portfolio, although the Apple executive stopped short of confirming when the changes could take effect. A tipster has now pointed to rapidly increasing memory prices as a key factor behind the company's urgency.
title: Memory Price Forecasts Reveal Why Apple Might Not Wait Until September to Hike iPhone, iPad and Mac Prices

description: Valve has finally launched the Steam Machine after a delay precipitated by ongoing memory and storage shortages. The company also revealed the price of the device. The Steam Machine starts at $1,049 in the US for the 512GB variant with no controller.
title: Valve Launches Steam Machine at $1,049, Says Price Reflects Cost of Components

description: Motorola Edge 70 Max could be launched as the sixth addition to the smartphone maker’s Edge 70 lineup, as the purported renders and key specifications of the rumoured handset have surfaced online. The Motorola Edge 70 series globally includes the standard Edge 70, Edge 70 Pro, Edge 70 Fusion, Edge 70 Fusion+, and the recently launched Edge 70 Pro+. The Motorola Edge 70 Max will reportedly be launched in three colour options, namely Glacier Blue, Onyx Black, and Sage Green. The handset is said to be equipped with a triple rear camera system, with a primary, telephoto, and ultrawide cameras.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Max Spotted in Leaked Marketing Material That Hints at Its Design, Key Features and an Imminent Debut

description: Google is said to be developing a new feature for Pixel that may allow users to keep track of both music and spoken interactions throughout the day. According to a report, the feature, dubbed Audio Memory, builds upon the existing Now Playing music recognition tool on Pixel phones. Discovered during an APK teardown, several strings hint towards the expansion of Pixel’s existing music recognition capabilities, while others hint at features that help store information about important conversations.
title: Google Reportedly Developing Audio Memory Feature for Pixel to Track Conversations, Music History

description: Oppo Reno 16 series will be launched in India on July 2, a tipster claims. The smartphone maker recently announced that the upcoming lineup will include two models, the Oppo Reno 16 and Reno 16c. However, the leaker further claims that the tech firm plans to also launch the Oppo Reno 16 Pro, which might arrive later in the country. The company recently started teasing the launch of the new Oppo Reno 16 series, which was launched in China in May. The Reno 16 will sport a 6.32-inch Full-HD+ AMOLED display that refreshes at 120Hz and offers up to 1,800 nits peak brightness.
title: Oppo Reno 16, Reno 16c India Launch Date Tipped; Reno 16 Pro Could Arrive Later

description: RedMagic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro will be launched in China on June 30. Ahead of the official reveal, the ZTE sub-brand Nubia has confirmed the design and a few specifications of the tablet. It is confirmed to be available in two colour options with a 9.06-inch OLED panel with an 185Hz refresh rate and 1600 nits peak brightness. The tablet has a Synaptics S3930 touch controller chip. The brand has opened pre-reservations for the RedMagic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro on its official online store in China.
title: RedMagic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro Launch Date Announced; Design, Display Details Revealed

description: The Samsung Galaxy S27 series is rumoured to feature four flagship models, marking a departure from the three-model strategy that has been followed since the Galaxy S20 series in 2020. In recent months, the rumour mill has suggested that the tech giant is exploring ways to differentiate the purported Galaxy S27 Pro from the rest of the lineup. Now, a tipster claims one of the ways it could do so is to adopt the privacy display feature that was exclusively introduced with the Galaxy S26 Ultra this year.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro Could Get Galaxy S26 Ultra's Privacy Display Feature, Tipster Claims

description: A joint warning was issued by intelligence and cybersecurity agencies from Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the UK, and the US on Monday. In a statement, the alliance, commonly known as the Five Eyes, said that AI has the potential to dramatically accelerate cyberattacks in the coming months. The agencies have warned against frontier AI models that have developed the capability of both offensive and defensive actions sooner than previously anticipated, claiming that cybersecurity cannot be treated purely as a cybersecurity issue anymore.
title: Frontier AI Models Just Months Away from Accelerating Cyberattacks, Five Eyes Intelligence Alliance Warns

description: WhatsApp on Monday announced that its global head, Will Cathcart, is stepping down after more than seven years at the helm of the world's largest messaging platform. The move marks a significant moment not just for WhatsApp, but also for India's technology ecosystem. This is because Meta Platforms announced that Kunal Shah, the founder of Indian fintech platform CRED, will succeed Cathcart. One of the country's most prominent startup entrepreneurs and angel investors, Shah is all set to become one of the highest-profile Indian executives to lead a major Meta-owned product.
title: Who is Kunal Shah? CRED Founder Named New Head of WhatsApp as Will Cathcart Steps Down
